# MeedyaDL 1.11.0-alpha.24

A small safety net for the queue: aborting everything is now undoable.

### What's new

- **Undo for "Abort Queue."** Accidentally hit the red "Abort Queue" button on a big queue? You now have 5 seconds to undo it — the same undo pattern already used for "Clear All" — so nothing is lost to a misclick. ([details](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/911))

### Notes

- This is a pre-release on the **alpha** channel — early access to work in progress. The in-app updater serves the latest stable unless you've opted into Alpha.
